sections.title: Habitat and form
sections.text: Marchantia polymorpha is a thalloid liverwort that colonises damp, shaded ground. Its flattened thallus forms rosettes or mats, with lobes about 5–10 mm wide.

sections.title: Reproduction
sections.text: This plant has neither flowers nor true roots. Cups on the thallus contain gemmae for vegetative reproduction; umbrella-shaped structures bear the sexual organs.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use is established in the sources consulted.
